verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI offers LLM-based structured extraction as an alternative to CSS/XPath selectors, and works with open-source and proprietary LLMs. Its CLI accepts a plain-language query such as -q "Extract all product prices", and custom schemas can define the structured JSON output. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the SDK's natural-language instruction parameter and how it combines with schemas, plus independent or hands-on confirmation of extraction accuracy.
